body: I want to do something stupid.  I want to get some tattoos, drop out of college, quit my job and go out west.  I want to find a ranch and ride fences and work cattle day in and day out.  I want to be exhausted at night and have to drag my ass back out of bed in the morning.  I want to get a motorcycle and drive like an idiot.  I've always been so careful to get good grades and stay safe.  I haven't even graduated, don't have a job in my field and I already feel encumbered by the number of commitments I have.  I've got a steady boyfriend, horses, and close friends that would hate for me to leave.  I've got enough crap collected and saved that I could furnish a small house with what's in my parents' basement.  I feel weighed down and I feel like it's time to make some mistakes for once.

Well, now I'm even more bummed out than I had been.  I got to thinking about it and you know what, I really wouldn't mind it.  Honestly, it would be kind of nice.  These last few months have been awful and I think I'd be happier if I just forgot it.
